validationOutput: Static trace of every mutation path (Open fresh/reuse, Save, Insert/Delete/Undo/Redo/SetMode, DocumentEdit, GetState/Move/Scroll/SetViewport, watch_disk) against ADR-0012
Event ring: bounded 128, oldest evicted, event.generation == snapshot.generation (daemon.rs:128-143)
Handshake: first-line Hello enforced, source derived from declared kind (daemon.rs:325-344, client.rs:76-79, session.rs:112-131)
External change: 2s poll, mismatch/deletion -> ExternalChange + bump + disk_changed, no auto-reload, baseline on fresh Open + Save
residualRisks: MAJOR: rejected oversized Insert (and other no-op/rejected ops) still bump generation and log events - record only on actual state change (daemon.rs:546)

MAJOR: reuse-Open does not refresh disk_baseline/disk_changed - after Open A -> Open B -> re-Open A, watch_disk skips (focused != baseline path) and external-change detection is silently off; disk_changed can describe the wrong doc (daemon.rs:397-401, 259-265)
MINOR: no-op deletes (pos-0 backspace, end-of-doc forward, point DeleteRange) bump generation and record Delete events
MINOR/AMBIGUOUS: SetMode takeover and preempt mode flips change undo grouping/mode without a SetMode event
Out-of-slice observation: DocumentEdit (apply_edit, daemon.rs:602) has no MAX_FILE_SIZE check, unlike Command::Insert - agent can grow memory beyond the ADR-0008 cap; flag to owner slice

reviewFindings: MAJOR: daemon.rs:520-546,804-805 - rejected oversized Insert bumps generation and records a false Insert event (spec: state unchanged -> no bump); no-op deletes (daemon.rs:524-533) same
MAJOR: daemon.rs:397-401 vs 431-438/496-503 - reuse-Open skips baseline refresh; watch_disk (259-265) then never stats the focused doc after multi-doc refocus; disk_changed may reflect the wrong file
MINOR: daemon.rs:538 + preempt (771-781) - takeover/group-boundary changes not reflected in events (AMBIGUOUS vs spec)
No blockers found in Hello handshake, ring bound (128), source labeling, or no-auto-reload external-change path - all CONFORMS
childReport.manualNotes: Reviewer has no shell tool: cargo test --workspace, cargo test -p mina-term, and gh issue view 9 must be executed by the supervisor (marked not-run). The two MAJOR findings (F1 rejected-op bump, F3 stale baseline on reuse-Open) are both currently invisible to the test suite - F1 because unit tests call apply_from directly (bypassing record_event), F3 because no test covers multi-doc refocus + external change. Suggested fixes are one-liner-ish: gate record_event on actual state change; refresh baseline on every Open including reuse.
